description: This file defines the API and data structures for the Bluetooth Mesh access layer, including model definitions, message handling, address and key management, and composition data.

methods.name: bt_mesh_model_send
methods.description: Sends an access layer message using the specified model, context, and message buffer.

methods.name: bt_mesh_model_publish
methods.description: Publishes a message from a model.

methods.name: bt_mesh_model_find
methods.description: Finds a SIG model within an element by model ID.

methods.name: bt_mesh_model_find_vnd
methods.description: Finds a vendor model within an element by company and model ID.

methods.name: bt_mesh_model_in_primary
methods.description: Checks if a model belongs to the primary element.

methods.name: bt_mesh_model_data_store
methods.description: Stores model user data in persistent storage.

methods.name: bt_mesh_model_data_store_schedule
methods.description: Schedules storing of model user data.

methods.name: bt_mesh_model_is_extended
methods.description: Checks if a model is extended by another.

methods.name: bt_mesh_comp_change_prepare
methods.description: Indicates that the composition data will change on next boot.

methods.name: bt_mesh_models_metadata_change_prepare
methods.description: Indicates that the models metadata will change on next boot.

methods.name: bt_mesh_comp2_register
methods.description: Registers composition data page 2 for the device.
